title.zh: Agent 工程为什么比看起来更难
title.en: Why agent engineering is harder than it looks

sourceText:
Good afternoon from Vienna People of Pi ☀️

Some slightly different Sunday meditations today in which @mitsuhiko talks about some shared frustrations with agentic software engineering.

Remember that you're not alone in finding it harder than it looks!

zh.title: 更强的模型没有消除工程难题
zh.text: Armin 反思使用 agent 工具一年半后的体验：模型能力确实提高了，但团队仍然面对信任、质量与理解上的老问题。

zh.title: 生成速度超过审查能力
zh.text: 代码和 PR 的产量增加，团队却很难同步提高审查能力。Armin 担心，持续追求更快交付会消耗维护质量所需的精力。

zh.title: 完成任务不等于写出好代码
zh.text: 他认为模型训练更奖励任务成功，而未必奖励可读、易审查的实现；一些工具调用和修改方式也让人更难跟踪模型在做什么。

zh.title: 失去理解，会在故障时付出代价
zh.text: Armin 描述一种令人担忧的情形：事故发生后，团队不断向机器提问，却缺乏对已提交代码的直接理解。他主张认真对待这种知识流失。

zh.title: 挫败感是共同经历
zh.text: 他同时表达了对这些工具的喜爱与失望，并呼吁改变工程实践。偶尔惊艳的结果并不能抵消长期返工，也不能说明困难只是用户不会写提示词。

en.title: Stronger models have not removed the hard parts
en.text: Armin reflects on eighteen months of agent tools: model capabilities have improved, while trust, quality and understanding remain difficult engineering problems.

en.title: Generation outpaces review
en.text: Growing volumes of code and pull requests strain a team’s ability to review. Armin worries that pressure to ship faster drains the energy needed to maintain standards.

en.title: Task success is not the same as good code
en.text: He argues that training rewards successful outcomes without necessarily rewarding readable, reviewable implementations. Some editing and tool-use patterns also make changes harder to follow.

en.title: Lost understanding becomes an incident risk
en.text: He describes teams responding to incidents by repeatedly consulting machines while lacking direct understanding of the committed code, and calls for taking that loss of knowledge seriously.

en.title: The frustration is shared
en.text: He expresses both enthusiasm and frustration, and calls for changes in engineering practice. Occasional impressive results do not erase prolonged rework or prove that every difficulty is a prompting failure.

segments.text: Hello, today it's just me. I want to talk with you a little bit about what's hard about AI software engineering.
segments.zh: 大家好，今天只有我。我想聊聊 AI 软件工程到底难在哪里。

segments.text: And this is in part because I got some really lovely emails recently where people shared their experiences,
segments.zh: 一方面，最近我收到一些很真诚的邮件，大家分享了自己的经历；

segments.text: but also because I asked on Twitter and I actually got a ton of responses.
segments.zh: 另一方面，我也在 Twitter 上问了这个问题，收到了很多回应。

segments.text: And really the question that I have sometimes is,
segments.zh: 我有时真的会想：

segments.text: how is it that after 18 months of using agentic software engineering tools like Claude Code,
segments.zh: 用了 Claude Code 这类 agent 软件工程工具十八个月，

segments.text: nothing really improved.
segments.zh: 怎么感觉什么都没改善？

segments.text: And I know this is a little bit not true because clearly the models are way more capable,
segments.zh: 我知道这么说不完全对，模型显然强了很多，

segments.text: but it didn't really feel like the hard problems are solved.
segments.zh: 但那些真正棘手的问题，似乎并没有解决。

segments.text: And in some ways things got worse.
segments.zh: 有些方面反而更糟了。

segments.text: And I think most consistently the problem that I
segments.zh: 我觉得最常见的问题，

segments.text: see that we have working ourselves with agentic tools,
segments.zh: 无论是我们自己使用 agent 工具时遇到的，

segments.text: as well as what I see other people report is really that because we haven't solved some of those fundamental problems.
segments.zh: 还是别人反馈的，归根结底都是一些基础问题还没有解决。

segments.text: Speed is now becoming
segments.zh: 现在，速度本身

segments.text: a new problem.
segments.zh: 成了一个新问题。

segments.text: It generates so many more pieces of code that our capacity to keeping up is going down and down.
segments.zh: 它生成的代码越来越多，我们却越来越跟不上。

segments.text: And it wouldn't be so
segments.zh: 其实这本来也不会

segments.text: bad if we just were willing to slow down, but we're not.
segments.zh: 那么糟，只要我们愿意慢下来。可我们不愿意。

segments.text: We're committing ourselves to being faster and faster.
segments.zh: 我们要求自己越来越快。

segments.text: And that's because we're no longer doing this alone.
segments.zh: 因为现在已经不是一个人在用这些工具了，

segments.text: We're doing this in teams.
segments.zh: 而是整个团队都在用。

segments.text: And I can't tell you how many of you have expressed
segments.zh: 不知道有多少人跟我表达过这种

segments.text: frustration about the fact that other people are sending you slop and other people are sending you
segments.zh: 挫败感：别人不断把粗制滥造的代码发过来，

segments.text: pull requests at their volume they just can't keep up with.
segments.zh: PR 的数量多到根本看不过来。

segments.text: And so we have this unfortunate situation where the models are both
segments.zh: 于是我们陷入了一种很尴尬的局面：模型

segments.text: getting really, really good, but not good enough that we still can't trust them.
segments.zh: 变得非常强，却还没有强到可以让我们放心信任。

segments.text: And this gap doesn't seem to be improving meaningfully.
segments.zh: 而这段差距，似乎没有明显缩小。

segments.text: And it's actually for me a huge problem right now on a very personal level, because I mean, I wrote about this before.
segments.zh: 对现在的我而言，这在个人层面上也是一个大问题。我以前也写过。

segments.text: I don't trust Astra and increasingly I don't trust Fable to be
segments.zh: 我不相信 Astra 能当好软件工程师，现在对 Fable 也越来越不信任，

segments.text: good software engineers, because what's happening in their training processes is that these models are
segments.zh: 因为在训练过程中，这些模型

segments.text: rewarded for succeeding, but not for writing code that I like.
segments.zh: 获得奖励是因为把任务完成了，而不是因为写出了我喜欢的代码。

segments.text: And in many ways, some of the behaviors you get out of these models now are counterproductive.
segments.zh: 它们现在的一些行为，在很多方面反而适得其反。

segments.text: They are,
segments.zh: 比如，

segments.text: for instance, no longer willing to use edit tools as much as they used to, which means that as I'm watching the edits fly by in
segments.zh: 它们不像以前那样愿意使用编辑工具了。这意味着，当我在

segments.text: Pi, very often I can't even understand what the model is doing,
segments.zh: Pi 里看着修改不断刷过时，常常连模型在做什么都看不明白，

segments.text: let alone which tools it's invoking.
segments.zh: 更别说知道它在调用哪些工具了。

segments.text: And so as all of this is going on and on, we're shipping faster.
segments.zh: 这些事情不断发生，而我们的交付速度越来越快。

segments.text: The quality of the code is deteriorating very quickly.
segments.zh: 代码质量却在迅速下降。

segments.text: And our
segments.zh: 而我们

segments.text: tenacity and energy is just not there anymore to
segments.zh: 已经没有那么多毅力和精力，

segments.text: apply the same kind of rigor and quality standards to it as we used to have.
segments.zh: 再像以前一样坚持同样严格的质量标准。

segments.text: And then we're increasingly losing understanding.
segments.zh: 我们对代码的理解也在不断流失。

segments.text: And I think one of the more devious parts about this is
segments.zh: 我觉得其中更隐蔽的危险在于：

segments.text: that in situations where my understanding is really,
segments.zh: 当某个场景真的非常需要

segments.text: really necessary, there are too many cases where seemingly nobody has it anymore.
segments.zh: 我们理解代码时，却常常发现似乎已经没人懂了。

segments.text: And I heard this story from friends I used to work with.
segments.zh: 以前一起工作的朋友跟我讲过这样的事。

segments.text: I had heard stories like this from people talking about it on Twitter that
segments.zh: 我也在 Twitter 上听人讲过类似的经历：

segments.text: you can now end up in an incident where a bunch of people
segments.zh: 出了故障，一群人

segments.text: are huddling in a Slack room trying to figure out what's going on.
segments.zh: 挤在 Slack 频道里，试图弄清楚发生了什么。

segments.text: And it's just all talking with the machines because nobody actually really wants to understand anymore, let alone understand the code that was committed.
segments.zh: 结果大家都只是在跟机器聊天，因为已经没人真想去理解了，更别说理解提交进去的代码。

segments.text: And that's not a situation that I think we should be encouraging.
segments.zh: 我觉得我们不应该鼓励这种局面。

segments.text: But I do want to let you know,
segments.zh: 但我想告诉大家，

segments.text: a lot of us are feeling like this right now.
segments.zh: 现在很多人都有这样的感受。

segments.text: And I think we owe it to us and our industry
segments.zh: 为了我们自己，也为了这个行业，

segments.text: to find solutions to this problem and not just
segments.zh: 我们有责任想办法解决这个问题，不能只是

segments.text: let it happen and not push back against this.
segments.zh: 任由它发生，什么抵抗都不做。

segments.text: This is a very shared experience.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常普遍的经历。

segments.text: And don't get me wrong.
segments.zh: 别误会，

segments.text: I love those tools.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这些工具。

segments.text: I think they're absolutely fascinating.
segments.zh: 它们确实非常迷人。

segments.text: And it is so many times just such a magical experience to work with them.
segments.zh: 很多时候，用它们的体验简直像魔法一样。

segments.text: But they are also deeply frustrating.
segments.zh: 但它们也让人非常沮丧。

segments.text: They're little machines where sometimes they produce an amazing result.
segments.zh: 这些小机器有时会给出惊人的结果，

segments.text: And then you're spending two weeks trying to massage one pull request into a shape that you like
segments.zh: 可接下来，你又得花两个星期反复调整一个 PR，想把它改成满意的样子，

segments.text: with no feeling of forward progress.
segments.zh: 却完全感觉不到在往前推进。

segments.text: And it seems to be random.
segments.zh: 而且这似乎是随机的。

segments.text: I don't know if it's just if me and my little community around us are just not the best
segments.zh: 我不知道，是不是我和身边这个小圈子的人都不太擅长

segments.text: prompters because I've heard that some people express that we're all just prompting wrong.
segments.zh: 写提示词。毕竟有人说，只是我们提示词写错了。

segments.text: But I think it's just hard.
segments.zh: 但我觉得，这件事本来就很难。

segments.text: And I just really felt like because
segments.zh: 我真的觉得，既然

segments.text: we're all, maybe not all of us, but because I think a lot of us struggling with this,
segments.zh: 我们——也许不是所有人，但至少很多人——都在为此挣扎，

segments.text: I think it's just good to let you know that you're not alone.
segments.zh: 那就应该让你知道：你不是一个人。

segments.text: And I think we probably need to do some changes here in how we approach certain
segments.zh: 我想，我们可能需要改变处理某些

segments.text: problems and how we engineer to actually really get to the bottom of it.
segments.zh: 问题的方式，改变工程实践，才能真正追到问题根源。

segments.text: Because better models and more capable models,
segments.zh: 因为更好、更强的模型，

segments.text: if anything, right now are making it a little bit worse by writing code that
segments.zh: 眼下反倒让情况更糟了一点：它们写出的代码

segments.text: is a lot less pleasant to look at and a lot harder to understand.
segments.zh: 看着难受得多，也难懂得多。

segments.text: So that's it for today. Have a nice weekend.
segments.zh: 今天就聊到这里。周末愉快。
